name: What is a Google Business Profile and how does it relate to website optimization?

mainEntity.name: What is a Google Business Profile and how does it relate to website optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Google Business Profile (GBP) is a free tool from Google that allows businesses to manage their online presence across Google Search and Maps. It's a cornerstone of local SEO. Optimizing your GBP with accurate information, photos, services, and responding to reviews directly impacts your visibility in local search results and the local pack. While distinct from your website, an optimized GBP drives traffic to your site and enhances your overall local online footprint, making it an integral part of your optimization strategy.
acceptedAnswer.description: A Google Business Profile (GBP) is a free tool for managing your local online presence on Google Search and Maps. An optimized GBP drives traffic to your website and boosts local visibility.
